topic: Case Study Spotlight: Sports App Redesign
content:
⚽ How we simplified complex sports analytics for thousands of active users:

In our latest project, we tackled a common UX challenge: presenting dense real-time data without cluttering the mobile viewport.

Key UX Wins:
• Reduced time-to-stat lookup by 40% using bottom-sheet contextual drawers.
• Implemented high-contrast dark mode optimized for outdoor sunlight visibility.
• Simplified navigation down to 3 core tabs based on user heatmaps.

Check out the full interactive case study on my portfolio link in the comments! 🚀
